goal: Excavate November 2025 predecessor host identities for Phoebus and WhoArt
body: Three-machine November audit produced hard Blade proof but a provenance gap for Phoebus/WhoArt. Verified: blade1tb tracker daily 2025-11-13 has 31 OpenAI Codex invocations, exact input 36,061, output 3,305, cache_read 189,696, reasoning 10,560, one distinct session. Migrated Watchtower Kaedra artifacts preserve last_active 2025-11-26T19:10:14 and explicit HQ_Blade knowledge integration on 2025-11-26. November tracker sweep: Blade 1 daily, Phoebus 0, WhoArt 0. Do NOT conclude absence. Action: map predecessor host aliases and original paths to current Phoebus and WhoArt, especially KushBoyGroups-Mac-mini / older Mac identities and Outpost / HQ_WhoArt / Windows aliases. Search original Antigravity/Gemini/Codex session metadata, filesystem/git metadata, old vault rows, tracker/raw provider logs from 2025-10 through 2025-12. Reject news/article/document dates and later federation source_node labels. Done when each current machine has earliest defensible work date with original artifact/path/session evidence, or a bounded no-proof result.
